versions.content: VLAN re-tagging All incoming messages at a CouplingPort where the CouplingPort . vlanModifier is defined shall be tagged with the VLAN- Id defined in CouplingPort . vlanModifier . This tagging is performed regardless whether the message already has a VLAN tag or is untagged, an existing VLAN tag shall be overwritten.
